notes.title: Surreal House is turning one year old!
notes.content:
[u][b]Surreal House is turning one year old on August 18, 2024![/b][/u]

To celebrate, the game will be on sale until August 19, 10 AM PDT.

To more years of puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388128/8222ad7b7c1b8959fea306bdcd72fa07d5536b6e.png[/img]

If you enjoyed Surreal House and want more, I am currently making a short narrative adventure (it's not puzzle driven like Surreal House, but don't worry the puzzles will be back in another game) focused on a weekend trip with friends.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744450/A_Weekend_Trip/]Wishlist it here![/url]

notes.content:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34107/Surreal_House_Collectors_Edition/]Click here to check it out![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388128/a14b3aa0adf56e187765fe9f224b3cec87232a1f.png[/img]

Surreal House is a point-and-click puzzle game inspired by escape rooms.
- a casual experience, a game where solving puzzles is the main focus
- no time pressure, solve at your own pace
- escape room inspired gameplay with different types of puzzles
- a tense and atmospheric original soundtrack​
- 2D art inspired by noir comic books

notes.title: Announcing my next game!
notes.content:
My next game is now up on Steam and ready to wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388128/3f226452962df52d4b56df08279ea4810fccdfc3.png[/img]

Play as River as they have a trip over the weekend with their friends. You get to choose what River does during the trip. Will you hang out with your friends? Will you explore the cabin? Or will you choose to just let the trip pass as quickly as possible. All these choices will affect your relationship with River's friends and will define what kind of person River is to them.

Will be updating more as development progresses. If any of this looks like something you would like to play why not stay tuned!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744450/A_Weekend_Trip/]Wishlist the game on Steam![/url]

notes.title: To fix the error on my end
notes.content:
Regarding a previous post last time about accidentally giving the art pack DLC for free, Steam has now fixed the packaging problem and it won't be given away for free anymore. For those who bought the game during the period however, the free DLC that you have gotten will probably not be in your Steam library anymore. 
Since that happened due to my mistake, I would like to offer the people who bought the game during August 18-19, 2023, a chance to get back the DLC that you have gotten for free. If you want the free DLC back, please email me on lukepagcagames@gmail.com and I will discuss privately with you what I need in order to give you back the DLC. If you think you don't need the free art pack DLC back then you don't have anything to worry about. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: An error on my end
notes.content:
Hello!
Due to an error in my part some people got the base game plus the art pack DLC for free. The error has been fixed on Steam's side so that people won't be getting the DLC for free anymore, but I am working with Steam to see if I can get the DLC for the people who already got it for free during this period, since the DLC might disappear now that the situation is fixed. Please be patient as I talk with Steam about this. Thank you and enjoy the game!
